changes.before: Requires electric public utilities to file tariffs for large load data centers at or above 100 MW peak load; assigns attributable costs to data centers and requires financial guarantees to protect other ratepayers.
changes.after: Directs BPU to set large data center service standards and a size threshold no greater than 50 MW, allocate attributable costs, and require utilities to file tariffs and financial protections, subject to statutory conditions and exceptions.
changes.reason: The 100 MW wording is struck in the enrolled text. The 50 MW limit is a ceiling on the threshold BPU sets, not a finding that BPU has set that threshold or that tariffs are in operation.
